name: asisya-qa-tests
description: Prueba técnica Ingeniero QA — Asisya. Automatización Frontend (Playwright) + API (Postman/Newman), debug, carga (JMeter) y seguridad.

scripts.test: npm run test:e2e && npm run test:api:ci
scripts.test:debug:original: node scripts/with-server.js "RUN_ORIGINAL=1 ORIGINAL_URL=http://localhost:3000 npx playwright test tests/debug/test-asistencia-falla.spec.ts"
scripts.test:api: newman run postman/Asisya-API.postman_collection.json -e postman/local.postman_environment.json -r cli,htmlextra,junit --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/newman/newman-report.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "Asisya API — Reporte Newman" --reporter-junit-export reports/junit/newman-results.xml
scripts.test:load: jmeter -n -t performance/seguimiento-carga.jmx -l reports/jmeter/resultados.jtl -e -o reports/jmeter/dashboard -f && node scripts/check-sla.js
scripts.test:load:ci: node scripts/with-server.js "$JMETER_HOME/bin/jmeter -n -t performance/seguimiento-carga.jmx -l reports/jmeter/resultados.jtl -e -o reports/jmeter/dashboard -f && node scripts/check-sla.js"

author: Robinson Damián Calderón Ávila
